description: All 9 issue #197 mutation tests are false positives: fixture_root/site is missing most required files (styles.css, robots.txt, etc.) before the #197 block runs, so check-site.sh exits 1 on required-files check before reaching #197 validation. Disabling the entire #197 block still passes all 9 mutations.
fix: Add cp -R "$repo_root/site/." "$fixture_root/site/" before the #197 block to restore full site contents

description: 5 of 15 #197 guards have no mutation test: displayed-command-exact, README pip-install, README @version, copy-button @version, WEBSITE.md fixture-path-reference
docs/WEBSITE.md not in pages.yml paths filter (pre-existing gap, not introduced by this change)
canonical_output and Rust expected stdout are independent hardcodings (intentional coordination point)
temp dir not cleaned up (consistent with existing pattern in conformance.rs/slice1.rs)

Guards 14/15 (copy-button install-pattern/@version) are unreachable: guards 10+11 already constrain copy_command to exactly 'pycc check hello.py', so install-pattern/@version checks can never fire. N4/M6 mutation tests are caught by guard 11 instead.
fix: Reorder: move install-pattern/@version checks on copy_button_data before guard 11 (equality check)

description: Structural parsing guards 3-6 (missing console fence, cat marker, command after cat, hello marker) have no mutation tests
Guard 2 (heading exact-match) is unreachable dead code: regex only matches '## Quick start' so the != check can never be True
M8 mutation test comment is misleading: says 'planned in README heading' but actually tests heading-existence guard 1
Redundant cp of index.html after cp -R already copies it

summary: README states the type-error example is quick_start.py plus one appended line, but nothing binds tests/diagnostics/quick_start_type_error.py's body to tests/fixtures/quick_start.py
note: Verified: the two files are in that relationship now (9 vs 10 lines, last line print(fib("5"))), and check-site.sh uses DIAGNOSTIC_SOURCE_REL only as a path string, never reading the body. Fixed by adding a binding.

summary: index_text read without CRLF normalization while readme_text (2418) and read_fixture (2241) both normalize
note: Verified by grep of every read_text() call site. Cannot break required CI (pages.yml runs check-site.sh on ubuntu-latest only) but is a real asymmetry in a script that reasons about this exact drift everywhere else. Fixed.

summary: Suite establishes the clean-fixture positive control once at the top; later failure-expecting mutations could pass vacuously if an earlier block left the fixture tree dirty
note: Reviewer verified each new #197 block re-copies its target fresh before mutating and the preceding block restores, and explicitly stated no action is required for this diff. Structural property of the file that predates this change; not fixed here to keep the diff scoped.

summary: The documented README_PATH env override is dead: readme_path is reassigned from site_dir, so a mutation that places the README at an arbitrary temp path silently passes
note: Surfaced when a proving mutation returned rc=0 and appeared to show the new guard did not exist. Confirmed pre-existing via git show 1fdf3511:scripts/check-site.sh. Existing mutations work only because they place the file at $fixture_root/README.md, which the site_dir derivation reconstructs. Left unfixed to keep the diff scoped; a live trap for any future README mutation that trusts the override.

summary: The QUICK_START_DIAGNOSTIC_SOURCE_PATH mutation inherits a dirty README from the unrestored block at 3222-3238 and fails at an earlier unrelated check, never reaching the new binding guard
note: Falsification run by the orchestrator: deleting check-site.sh:2527-2551 outright and running ./scripts/test-check-site.sh still exits 0 with 'Website validator self-tests passed.' The guard's own logic is sound; its tests are vacuous.

summary: The two appended-line-claim mutations are masked by a dirty site/index.html left by the unrestored block at 3159-3172, which removes every occurrence of tests/quick_start.rs and later trips the hero-provenance check independently of the guard under test
note: Same falsification run confirms it: with the guard deleted the suite still passes. Both mutations currently fail for the right reason only by coincidence of check ordering.

summary: No mutation exercises rejection of a changed line within the fixture's existing nine lines, only an added line
note: Correct by construction (full-string equality) but untested at that edge.

summary: Round-2 blockers resolved in 95b7d4f4 by restoring mutated fixtures at the source of the dirt
note: Independently re-verified by the orchestrator after the fix: deleting check-site.sh:2518-2551 now makes ./scripts/test-check-site.sh exit 1 with 'Validator accepted a diagnostic source that is not the quick-start fixture plus one line (issue #197)'. Restore confirmed byte-identical. The implementer additionally ran each of the four mutations in isolation both with and without the guard, establishing causation per-mutation rather than once over the suite.

summary: Changed-line rejection now exercised by a fourth mutation altering an early line of the diagnostic source
note: Added in 95b7d4f4; line count unchanged so only full-string equality rejects it.

title: Mutation blocks leave shared fixtures dirty; later blocks fail on the wrong guard
detail: Independently verified and found wider than reported: 18 sites in test-check-site.sh's #197 section are vacuous, not 2. Established by instrumenting all 106 guarded check-site.sh invocations with line markers and capturing each one's stderr, then pairing it with the block's own 'Validator accepted ...' string. git blame plus git merge-base --is-ancestor put every flagged block on origin/main (269c7f5b, 078d87e2, b36feec8); this PR's ae6ef741 added only three assert lines inside them. Diffing the instrumented message sequences at 1fdf3511 and at HEAD shows this diff does not change which blocks are vacuous.
resolution: Filed as https://github.com/rotnov/pycc/issues/644 with the full marker table and the restore_fixtures() invariant proposal. Not fixed here: 18 sites, a shared harness invariant, and un-masking will require new check-site.sh guards - a separate seam per AGENTS.md decomposition. Scope fork resolved via the session's advisor tool per D-127, which set the merge condition as 'no site regressed relative to base' rather than 'all vacuity fixed'.

title: check-site.sh:2046 reassigns readme_path, killing the README_PATH override
detail: Confirmed pre-existing via git show 1fdf3511:scripts/check-site.sh. The override established at line 8 is dead for every consumer below 2046; existing mutations work only because they place the file where the site_dir derivation reconstructs it. This is a contributing root cause of the vacuity above, not an independent defect.
resolution: Folded into issue #644 as the contributing root cause; they share one fix shape.

title: Regression check on the new diagnostic-source binding guard
detail: The new guard preempts the pre-existing hero-source check at test-check-site.sh:2744, which was the one message that changed between base and HEAD. Verified non-blocking two ways: deleting the guard (check-site.sh:2518-2551) returns 2744 to the pre-existing hero-source rejection, so the mutation is genuinely rejected by both invariants; and the hero-source check retains two other exercising sites (2724, 2764). Deleting the guard also turns the suite red at its own test, proving the guard is load-bearing.

title: Instrumentation artifact, not a state fragility
detail: An earlier instrumented run returned rc=1 at line 3265. Cause: the marker was inserted between the two lines of a backslash-continued if, so QUICK_START_DIAGNOSTIC_PATH never reached check-site.sh. Re-running with continuation-safe insertion returns rc=0 at both base and HEAD.
resolution: Instrumentation fixed; no defect in the tree.
